name: Amylu Roasted Garlic & Mozzarella Chicken Meatballs (Costco)
whyItWorks: Lean chicken breast and thigh meat rolled with mozzarella and herbs, fully cooked and gluten-free. Free of dense breadcrumb fillers and deep-frying grease found in standard beef meatballs.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Simmer in smooth strained marinara sauce or warm in broth. Pair with tender penne or sourdough toast.
